title: Results of the seventh population census in the Kingdom of the Netherlands, December 31st 1889
descriptions: The dataset is based on two separate censuses of the Netherlands of 1889, population census (13 vols) and occupational census (13 vols). Content: images of the publication, searchable pdf files of the text sections and excel files with data entered from the published tables.
